## Product Summary
Free website live chat, shared inbox, mobile customer support app, and automatic translation for customer messages.
Auto translate customer conversations into 100+ languages.

## Key Product Facts
- Chataptor is a free customer communication tool with no message limits.
- Chataptor includes website live chat, a shared omnichannel inbox, mobile customer support, e-commerce and marketplace messaging, and automatic customer conversation translation.
- The product is designed for companies that want to answer customers from many channels and languages without adding a separate language team.
- Chataptor is especially relevant for live chat, customer support, e-commerce support, international sales, automatic translation, and messages in one place.

## Main Capabilities
- Live chat on your website: Add a widget to your site and create a new contact channel without rebuilding anything.
- One inbox for messages: All conversations land in one organized support workspace.
- Automatic AI translation: Chataptor translates customer messages and your replies in real time.
- Mobile app: Get notifications and reply from your phone in your own language.

## Setup
- Create a Live Chat channel: Name it, set your team language, and copy the ready code.
- Paste the snippet: Add it to your website, CMS, or online store.
- Messages land in Chataptor: Every question from the widget arrives in the same inbox as your other channels.
- Reply from web or mobile: Write in English and Chataptor translates the answer for the customer.

## Pricing
Chataptor is currently free to use with no message limits. You can launch live chat, a shared inbox, and automatic translations without a separate starting budget.
- No message limits
